mapper.select: SELECT uuid, name, menu_id, role_id, user_id, person_type, status, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time FROM sys_permission WHERE person_type = 1 AND role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY uuid ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT p.menu_id FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.uuid = p.menu_id WHERE p.person_type = 1 AND p.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.menu_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET status = 0, update_user_id = #{operatorId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE person_type = 1 AND role_id = #{roleId}
UPDATE sys_permission SET status = 1, update_user_id = #{operatorId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{permissionId} AND role_id = #{roleId} AND person_type = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (uuid, name, menu_id, role_id, user_id, person_type, status, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{name}, #{menuId}, #{roleId}, #{userId}, #{personType}, #{status}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
